definitions.explanation: The combined systems that supply clean water to and drain wastewater from a building or facility.

examples.japanese: {給排水|きゅうはいすい}の{工事|こうじ}をする。
examples.english: Carry out water-supply and drainage work.

examples.japanese: マンションの{給排水|きゅうはいすい}{設備|せつび}を{点検|てんけん}する。
examples.english: Inspect the plumbing of the apartment building.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{建物|たてもの}では、{給排水|きゅうはいすい}の{配管|はいかん}が{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}していることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In old buildings, the water-supply and drainage pipes are often deteriorated.

notes:
A combined term blending {給水|きゅうすい} (water supply) + {排水|はいすい} (drainage). Common in construction, real estate, and building maintenance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給排水|きゅうはいすい}{設備|せつび}: water-supply and drainage equipment; plumbing
- {給排水|きゅうはいすい}{工事|こうじ}: plumbing work
- {給排水|きゅうはいすい}{管|かん}: water-supply and drainage pipes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {給水|きゅうすい}: water supply — only the incoming-water half
- {排水|はいすい}: drainage — only the wastewater half
